restaurant_name: First Vision ร้านแว่นตา โดยนักทัศนมาตร เชียงใหม่
text:
I was very impressed with "First Vision," a small eyewear shop with exceptional quality and ethics.
At my age of 60+, vision is extremely important. Recently, I experienced blurred vision while driving. I wasn't sure if it was due to a change in my prescription or another eye health issue, so I decided to consult with First Vision, which is run by May, an optometrist, and her father.
What impressed me the most:
The care goes beyond just selling: From the moment I stepped in, May greeted me warmly and provided detailed information about my near and far vision problems. Most importantly, she possessed "high ethical standards." She didn't focus on pushing glasses, but rather on finding the root cause of the problem.
The most thorough eye examination I've ever experienced: May spent a considerable amount of time conducting a very detailed initial eye examination. She then scheduled a follow-up appointment for me to bring my old glasses in for a more accurate comparison of my prescription.
Honesty towards customers: The conclusion was that my prescription hadn't changed significantly, but May analyzed that the blurred vision was likely due to "dry eyes" and recommended that I see an ophthalmologist for proper treatment, without charging me for the initial examination.
In conclusion: If you're looking for a high-quality eyewear shop, I highly recommend this place. Even though it's a small shop, the service is excellent. The owner is a graduate in optometry and personally takes care of customers. She's knowledgeable, explains things clearly, and is very honest with customers.
A big thank you to May and her father from First Vision for taking such good care of us.
